subject: Request: shift demo to allow prep window and access setup

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: shift demo to allow prep window and access setup

Hi Lydia / team,

Quick note — we were due to run the Acme demo this Thursday at 11am PT. After reviewing the prompt sets and the sample traces you sent, our engineering team is asking for a short prep window to:
- finalize the prompt set that mirrors your primary workflow,
- load a small set of workload traces into the staging instance, and
- provision the read-only S3 access for demo-side data sampling.

Would you be open to moving the demo ~48–72 hours later so we can complete this prep? Suggested windows:
- Mon 27 Jul 14:00–15:00 PT
- Tue 28 Jul 10:00–11:00 PT

If those don't work, tell us three windows that do and we'll prioritize. We want the demo to show the same prompts and traces you'll run in production so the results are meaningful.

Thanks — I can coordinate access instructions if we settle on a slot.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

1) We can't share production data; the sample CSV should be clearly synthetic or masked.

Attachments (stubs attached to this thread):
- acme_prompt_set_v1.json — sanitized prompt set aligned to the three primary workflows you described.
- workload_traces_sample.csv — synthetic traces following the CSV schema we discussed.
- access_instructions.md — one-page IAM policy snippet, exact S3 prefix, and steps for creating a temporary read-only role.

- We'll start with the smallest prompt to demonstrate latency, then run the two medium workloads.
- If anything looks inconsistent, we'll toggle quantization-safe model variant for parity with your production results.
